main.script: {"@graph":[{"url":"https://amityonline.com","name":"UGC approved UG/PG Online Degrees Amity Online","@type":"WebPage","@context":"https://schema.org/","speakable":{"@type":"SpeakableSpecification","xPath":["/html/head/title","/html/head/meta[@name='description']/@content"]}},{"url":"https://amityonline.com","logo":"https://amityonline.com/_s/amity_logo_5ee70d67b4_f4e929fb4a.svg","name":"Amity Online","@type":"Organization","sameAs":["https://www.facebook.com/AmityOnlineUniversity","https://twitter.com/amity_online","https://www.instagram.com/amityonline/","https://www.youtube.com/amityuniversityonline","https://www.linkedin.com/school/amityonline"],"address":{"@type":"PostalAddress","postalCode":"201301","addressRegion":"Uttar Pradesh ","streetAddress":"Amity University, Campus, N-Block, Sector 125, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301","addressCountry":"India","addressLocality":"Noida"},"@context":"https://schema.org","contactPoint":{"@type":"ContactPoint","email":"support@amityonline.com","telephone":"1800-102-3434","areaServed":"IN","contactType":"Admission Related Queries","contactOption":"TollFree","availableLanguage":["en","Hindi"]}},{"@type":"FAQPage","@context":"https://schema.org","mainEntity":[{"name":"What Is The Admission Process Of Amity Online?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"The admission process for Amity Online involves selecting your preferred course, submitting the online application form along with necessary documents,","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How Do I Access My Course?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"After receiving login credentials of LMS, enrolled students can start with the program. All the course related information is structured in LMS through which students can access their live sessions, study materials, assignments and more. Learners can access all the study material 24X7. So, you can study at your own pace and time at your convenience.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Where I Can See The Academic Calendar For My Degree Program?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Students can see their academic calendar in the student zone accessible through the LMS.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How Will I Get Admission Confirmation?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Once your admission process is completed and enrollment number is generated, our support team will get in touch with you for admission confirmation.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"What Kind Of Study Material Is Given?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Semester wise videos are available in student zone and program books are also couriered at registered address.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Where Do I Get The Assignments?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"You can get the assignments in student zone.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"When Does The Admission Start In Amity University Online For All Programs?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"There are two sessions, one starts from 1st January to April and second starts from 1st July to September.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Cancellation Of Admission","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Cancellation of admission will be granted on the special approval from competent authority on case to case basis.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How To Obtain The Admission Letter?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Once the enrollment number is generated, an e-mail will be sent to the learner with login details. This mail can be considered as admission letter.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"What Is Amity University Online?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Amity University Online is the online learning platform of Amity University, one of India's leading private universities. It offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma programs across various disciplines, delivered entirely online.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How Does Online Learning With Amity University Online Work?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Our online learning platform provides students with access to course materials, lectures, assignments, and discussions through an intuitive and user-friendly interface. Students can engage with their studies at their own pace and convenience, accessing resources from anywhere with an internet connection.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Are The Programs Offered By Amity University Online Accredited?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Yes, all programs offered by Amity University Online are accredited by the relevant accreditation bodies. Our online degree programs are recognized and respected by employers and institutions worldwide.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"What Are The Admission Requirements For Amity University Online Programs?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Admission requirements vary depending on the program and level of study. Generally, applicants are required to meet certain academic qualifications and need to submit documents such as transcripts, national identity cards.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How Are Online Classes Conducted?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Online classes are conducted through live lectures, pre-recorded videos, interactive discussions, and virtual classrooms. Students can participate in real-time or access recordings later, providing flexibility to accommodate various schedules and time zones.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Can I Interact With Faculty And Classmates In An Online Program?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Yes, our online programs encourage interaction and collaboration among students and faculty. You can engage in discussions, ask questions, and seek guidance from instructors and classmates through various online communication channels.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"What Academic Support Services Are Available To Online Students?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Amity University Online offers a range of academic support services to help students succeed, including academic advising and technical support.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How Are Exams And Assessments Conducted In Online Programs?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Assessments may vary depending on the course but typically include a combination of quizzes, assignments, and projects. Exams are conducted through a remote online proctoring system and can be taken from anywhere.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Can I Transfer Credits Earned From Other Institutions To Amity University Online Programs?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Yes, we accept transfer credits from accredited institutions, subject to evaluation and approval by our admissions team.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How Do I Apply For An Online Program At Amity University Online?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"To apply for an online program, simply visit our website, select the program you're interested in, and follow the application instructions provided.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Are Student Loans Available For Online Students?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"To apply for an online program, simply visit our website, select the program you're interested in, and follow the application instructions provided.","@type":"Answer"}}]},{"url":"https://amityonline.com","name":"Amity Online","@type":"WebSite","@context":"https://schema.org/","potentialAction":{"@type":"SearchAction","target":"{search_term_string}","query-input":"required name=search_term_string"}}],"@context":"https://schema.org/"}

26:T1d7b,{"@graph":[{"url":"https://amityonline.com","name":"UGC approved UG/PG Online Degrees Amity Online","@type":"WebPage","@context":"https://schema.org/","speakable":{"@type":"SpeakableSpecification","xPath":["/html/head/title","/html/head/meta[@name='description']/@content"]}},{"url":"https://amityonline.com","logo":"https://amityonline.com/_s/amity_logo_5ee70d67b4_f4e929fb4a.svg","name":"Amity Online","@type":"Organization","sameAs":["https://www.facebook.com/AmityOnlineUniversity","https://twitter.com/amity_online","https://www.instagram.com/amityonline/","https://www.youtube.com/amityuniversityonline","https://www.linkedin.com/school/amityonline"],"address":{"@type":"PostalAddress","postalCode":"201301","addressRegion":"Uttar Pradesh ","streetAddress":"Amity University, Campus, N-Block, Sector 125, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301","addressCountry":"India","addressLocality":"Noida"},"@context":"https://schema.org","contactPoint":{"@type":"ContactPoint","email":"support@amityonline.com","telephone":"1800-102-3434","areaServed":"IN","contactType":"Admission Related Queries","contactOption":"TollFree","availableLanguage":["en","Hindi"]}},{"@type":"FAQPage","@context":"https://schema.org","mainEntity":[{"name":"What Is The Admission Process Of Amity Online?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"The admission process for Amity Online involves selecting your preferred course, submitting the online application form along with necessary documents,","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How Do I Access My Course?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"After receiving login credentials of LMS, enrolled students can start with the program. All the course related information is structured in LMS through which students can access their live sessions, study materials, assignments and more. Learners can access all the study material 24X7. So, you can study at your own pace and time at your convenience.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Where I Can See The Academic Calendar For My Degree Program?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Students can see their academic calendar in the student zone accessible through the LMS.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How Will I Get Admission Confirmation?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Once your admission process is completed and enrollment number is generated, our support team will get in touch with you for admission confirmation.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"What Kind Of Study Material Is Given?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Semester wise videos are available in student zone and program books are also couriered at registered address.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Where Do I Get The Assignments?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"You can get the assignments in student zone.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"When Does The Admission Start In Amity University Online For All Programs?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"There are two sessions, one starts from 1st January to April and second starts from 1st July to September.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Cancellation Of Admission","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Cancellation of admission will be granted on the special approval from competent authority on case to case basis.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How To Obtain The Admission Letter?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Once the enrollment number is generated, an e-mail will be sent to the learner with login details. This mail can be considered as admission letter.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"What Is Amity University Online?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Amity University Online is the online learning platform of Amity University, one of India's leading private universities. It offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma programs across various disciplines, delivered entirely online.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How Does Online Learning With Amity University Online Work?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Our online learning platform provides students with access to course materials, lectures, assignments, and discussions through an intuitive and user-friendly interface. Students can engage with their studies at their own pace and convenience, accessing resources from anywhere with an internet connection.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Are The Programs Offered By Amity University Online Accredited?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Yes, all programs offered by Amity University Online are accredited by the relevant accreditation bodies. Our online degree programs are recognized and respected by employers and institutions worldwide.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"What Are The Admission Requirements For Amity University Online Programs?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Admission requirements vary depending on the program and level of study. Generally, applicants are required to meet certain academic qualifications and need to submit documents such as transcripts, national identity cards.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"How Are Online Classes Conducted?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Online classes are conducted through live lectures, pre-recorded videos, interactive discussions, and virtual classrooms. Students can participate in real-time or access recordings later, providing flexibility to accommodate various schedules and time zones.","@type":"Answer"}},{"name":"Can I Interact With Faculty And Classmates In An Online Program?","@type":"Question","acceptedAnswer":{"text":"Yes, our online programs encourage interaction and collaboration among students and faculty. <script>
 (function () {
var targetDate = new Date('2026-09-25T23:59:59');

function pad(n) {
 return String(n).padStart(2, '0');
}

function updateCountdown() {
 var now = new Date();
 var diff = targetDate - now;

 var daysEl = document.getElementById('scholarship-countdown-days');
 var hoursEl = document.getElementById('scholarship-countdown-hours');
 var minutesEl = document.getElementById('scholarship-countdown-minutes');
 var secondsEl = document.getElementById('scholarship-countdown-seconds');

 if (!daysEl) return;

 if (diff <= 0) {
 daysEl.textContent = '00';
 hoursEl.textContent = '00';
 minutesEl.textContent = '00';
 secondsEl.textContent = '00';
 return;
 }

 var days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
 var hours = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
 var minutes = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
 var seconds = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);

 daysEl.textContent = pad(days);
 hoursEl.textContent = pad(hours);
 minutesEl.textContent = pad(minutes);
 secondsEl.textContent = pad(seconds);
}

updateCountdown();
setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);
})();

35:Tba9,

Everything You're Wondering About—Answered

36:T578,

Students have access to:

  • Live and recorded lectures by experienced Indian & global faculty and industry experts.
  • E-books, physical study materials, and case studies.
  • Collaborative activities and webinars.
37:T797,

The admission process is simple:

  • Select your program and complete the online application form.
  • Upload the required documents and pay the registration fee.
  • Upon acceptance, confirm your enrollment by making the program fee payment.

The admissions team and AI-Professor AMI are available to assist at every step.

38:T8f0,

Amity University Online is a leader in online education, offering:

  • India's first UGC-approved online university programs.
  • The only QS-ranked online MBA program in India.
  • Flexible learning schedules with renowned faculty and global networking opportunities.
  • Comprehensive learning resources, including live sessions, recorded lectures, and interactive content.
  • AI-Professor AMI, providing 24/7 academic support for doubt resolution and guidance.
  • beSociall, a virtual campus experience with webinars, gamified activities, peer networking, and program-specific channels.
  • Industry visits for practical exposure, enabling students to connect with professionals and apply theoretical knowledge in real-world settings.
39:T5f8,

Admission requirements vary by program:

  • For undergraduate programs: Completion of 10+2.
  • For postgraduate programs: A bachelor's degree is required.
  • Academic certificates and a valid government-issued ID.
  • Some programs may require additional eligibility tests.
3a:Tf61,

For a smooth admission process, the following documents are required:
For Domestic Students:

  • Academic certificates from 10th, 12th, and graduation.
  • Consolidated marksheets for graduation.
  • A valid government-issued ID such as Aadhar, PAN, or Passport.

For International Students:

  • O Level and A Level certificates or equivalent qualifications.
  • Bachelor's degree certificate with consolidated marksheets.
  • Passport copy (mandatory).

Once these documents are ready, our admissions team will guide you through the process.

3b:T5f2,

Amity University Online offers:

  • AI-Professor AMI powered by Chat-GPT 4 & OpenAI technology, available 24/7 for instant doubt clearing, academic guidance, and technical support.
  • Dedicated student support through calls and chat for resolving queries.
  • Career assistance, including placement support and resume-building workshops.
3c:T710,

Learning at Amity University Online is conducted through a sophisticated student portal, offering 24/7 access to:

  • Live lectures, recorded sessions, assignments, and quizzes.
  • Assignments, quizzes, proctored examinations and other academic resources.
  • Support from AI-Professor AMI for a seamless and engaging learning experience.
  • Students can also enhance their experience through beSocial, which offers collaboration and networking opportunities.

div.p: Global Education Has a New Address: Yours.
No matter your career path, we have programs tailored for tomorrow’s global opportunities.
India’s only Online MBA ranked by QS among the Asia Pacific Top 10.
Accredited by the Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC), a globally respected recognition of academic quality..
Ranked by Times Higher Education for strong graduate employability and employer reputation.
Accredited by the UK’s Quality Assurance Agency (QAA), reflecting internationally benchmarked academic standards.
Recognized by World Education Services (WES) for degree evaluation in Canada and the USA.
Ranked among India’s top universities by the National Institutional Ranking Framework

div.h2: Why Say Yes to Amity Online
div.p: Globally recognized | Digitally advanced | Deeply personalized
Study in formats that suit you — videos, visuals, interactive exercises — designed for faster understanding and real-world application
AI summaries, smart practice questions, built-in note tools — all in one intuitive,immersive learning environment built to keep you ahead.
Prof. AMI 3.0 guides you through assignments, clears doubts instantly, and keeps you on track — anytime, anywhere.
Solve real business challenges with industry experts. Earn project certifications and build a recruiter-ready portfolio before you graduate.
Attend orientations, meetups, and convocation across Amity campuses — combining digital flexibility with real-world community.
Earn in-demand credentials to strengthen your CV from day one. Boost your skills with Certification in AI — embedded into your degree.
From resume building and mock interviews to job search tools — get structured, career support that moves you faster toward placements.
Network, join clubs, attend events, and build meaningful connections in a vibrant online-first community.

div.p: My global learning journey taught me resilience, adaptability, and purpose. Every challenge became a step towards a stronger comeback.
With 18+ years in IT leadership, Amity Online helped me upskill flexibly with practical learning, great faculty, and real career impact.
While pursuing my MBA, I launched my startup, Welexo, to make global trade intelligence accessible for businesses of all sizes.
Being a working professional, my three-year journey with Amity Online has been smooth, flexible, and truly enjoyable. Excited to continue learning further.
As a Strategic Planning Manager, I value Amity Online’s flexibility, supportive faculty, and excellent student support. Truly worth the investment.
Grateful to Amity Online Career Services for their constant support, guidance, and mentorship in helping secure my HR internship at Inorg.
An Amity Online BBA alumnus turned his degree into a global career opportunity, securing an international placement in Sofia, Bulgaria, Europe.
I never stopped learning, even while raising a family — balancing responsibilities and ambition without putting my dreams on hold.
I upskilled myself, embraced new opportunities, and confidently switched career paths to build a better future and move forward with purpose.
My pincode never defined my potential. Amity Online gave me the flexibility and confidence to dream bigger from Goa to global opportunities.

div.p: Amity University Online is India's first UGC-approved online university offering globally recognized online undergraduate, postgraduate, and certificate programs. Designed for working professionals and students, the platform provides the flexibility to advance education and careers without compromising existing commitments.

button.class: flex justify-between items-center cursor-pointer py-1 w-full text-left FaqWithoutCategory-module-scss-module__HQ-QOa__faqQues

div.p: Yes, Amity University Online is fully accredited by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and meets global academic standards. It is the only Indian institution offering a QS-ranked online MBA program and also holds accreditations from AICTE and WASC.

button.class: flex justify-between items-center cursor-pointer py-1 w-full text-left FaqWithoutCategory-module-scss-module__HQ-QOa__faqQues
button.h3: What sets Amity University Online apart?

span.span: Amity University Online is a leader in online education, offering:

ul.li: India's first UGC-approved online university programs.
The only QS-ranked online MBA program in India.
Flexible learning schedules with renowned faculty and global networking opportunities.
Comprehensive learning resources, including live sessions, recorded lectures, and interactive content.
AI-Professor AMI, providing 24/7 academic support for doubt resolution and guidance.
beSociall, a virtual campus experience with webinars, gamified activities, peer networking, and program-specific channels.
Industry visits for practical exposure, enabling students to connect with professionals and apply theoretical knowledge in real-world settings.

button.class: flex justify-between items-center cursor-pointer py-1 w-full text-left FaqWithoutCategory-module-scss-module__HQ-QOa__faqQues
button.h3: What support services are available for students?

ul.li: AI-Professor AMI powered by Chat-GPT 4 & OpenAI technology, available 24/7 for instant doubt clearing, academic guidance, and technical support.
Dedicated student support through calls and chat for resolving queries.
Career assistance, including placement support and resume-building workshops.

button.class: flex justify-between items-center cursor-pointer py-1 w-full text-left FaqWithoutCategory-module-scss-module__HQ-QOa__faqQues
button.h3: How does online learning at Amity University Online work?

span.span: Learning at Amity University Online is conducted through a sophisticated student portal, offering 24/7 access to:

ul.li: Live lectures, recorded sessions, assignments, and quizzes.
Assignments, quizzes, proctored examinations and other academic resources.
Support from AI-Professor AMI for a seamless and engaging learning experience.
Students can also enhance their experience through beSocial, which offers collaboration and networking opportunities.

button.class: flex justify-between items-center cursor-pointer py-1 w-full text-left FaqWithoutCategory-module-scss-module__HQ-QOa__faqQues
button.h3: Can credits from other institutions be transferred?

div.p: Yes, Amity University Online evaluates transfer credits on a case-by-case basis to ensure they meet program requirements. The admissions team guides students through this process.

button.class: flex justify-between items-center cursor-pointer py-1 w-full text-left FaqWithoutCategory-module-scss-module__HQ-QOa__faqQues

div.p: Exams are conducted online in a secure and proctored environment on our student portal to maintain academic integrity. Mock exams are provided to familiarize students with the system. Flexible time slots are offered to accommodate learners' schedules.
